name: Saint SPD pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 545 g for the left/right PD-M821 SPD pedal pair, from the explicit /pair weight row in the 2025–2026 specification handbook. The handbook describes four height-adjustable pins; the exact pin-height setting for its weight is not specified. No pin mass is added or deducted. The handbook notes a supplied 1.0 mm cleat spacer; the weight row does not enumerate cleats or loose accessories.
